topPRs.title: docs: update governance pages and redirect deleted pages to the FAQ
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
Replaces #23785. Its checks would not rerun from the fork, so this PR carries the same changes on a branch in this repo and adds redirects.

**From #23785 (content unchanged):**
1. Remove the outdated EAS attestation pages (`governance/eas-attestations`, `governance/attestation-schemas`).
2. Remove outdated language (e.g. Superchain, RPGF, Citizens' House).
3. Update the Protocol Upgrades page to reflect the current process (e.g. no more DAB), and refresh the FAQ.

Includes the fixes from internal review: the corrected Foundation director name in the FAQ, the typo fix on the Protocol Upgrades page, and the kept Decentralization Milestone / Decision Diagram and Superchain Health Dashboard links on the resources page. The first commit keeps @JSeiferth as author.

**New in this PR:**
- Redirect `/governance/eas-attestations` and `/governance/attestation-schemas` to `/governance/gov-faq`, so existing links and bookmarks keep working.
- Repoint the `/identity/optimist-profile` and `/chain/identity/optimist-profile` redirects, which pointed at `attestation-schemas`, straight to the FAQ so they don't chain through a deleted page.
- Drop the sentence on `op-stack/protocol/smart-contracts` that linked to the deleted attestations page.

Prompted by: @sbvegan
